info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Account Transaction Push API
info.description: The Customer Account Transaction Push API enables businesses to efficiently send transaction data related to specific customer accounts. This API allows for the seamless transmission of transaction updates, ensuring that consumers are promptly notified about the status of their account activities. Typical users of this API include financial institutions and business applications that need to keep account holders informed in real-time. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can enhance customer engagement and improve transaction visibility, leading to more informed financial decisions.

post.summary: Push a transaction to a specific account.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to push a transaction for a specified account, identified by customer and account IDs. It is designed to facilitate the integration of external transaction data into our system seamlessly.
